BETA Close X Serco Group plc has executed further share purchases as part of its ongoing buyback program, acquiring a total of 1,367,599 ordinary shares between July 13 and July 17, 2026. The average price paid per share across these transactions was approximately 227.76 pence, with the lowest price at 223.80 pence and the highest at 230.60 pence. Following these purchases, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 977,451,902, with 25,294,112 shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 17 July 2026 17 July 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
